thread:
Maya: quick RFC follow-up re: token audience binding and JWKS rotation. We saw a spike of auth rejects when a few runtimes failed to fetch new keys. Need a low-risk approach + runbook.
Raj: yeah, ~450 auth failures across ingress gateways when keyset rotated and caches were stale. cause: aggressive cache TTL + no fallback audience.
Priya: two concerns: 1) kid rotation propagation, 2) token audience mismatch when proxies rewrite aud claim. both caused rejects.
Tom: proposed mitigations: 1) accept multiple audiences per service (aud list) during rollout, 2) JWKS cache grace window + background refresh, 3) token kid acceptance: if kid not found, try remote fetch with linear backoff before rejecting.
Maya: for (1) how long do we allow dual-audience? we need a bounded window to avoid permanent loosen.
Tom: default 15m dual-audience window controlled by service manifest: aud_rollout_window_secs (default 900). Platform can shorten/extend per risk.
Raj: caching: runtime should keep stale keys for short grace (e.g., 60s) and in-parallel refresh. If refresh fails, continue verifying with stale keys for grace period and emit metric jwks.refresh.fail.
Priya: also require servers to log X-Token-Aud and X-Validated-KID headers for tracing. ops playbook can query these to see which nodes are failing key refresh.
Maya: runbook sketch: 1) Alert when auth.reject.rate by code=="invalid_aud" or code=="kid_not_found" spikes > threshold. 2) Identify affected route/nodes via X-Validated-KID and node.metric.jwks_last_fetch. 3) If jwks.fetch.failure across >10% nodes -> trigger platform job to clear cache and force refresh (rolling). 4) If still failing, rollback new token rollout by toggling aud_rollout_window to 0 (revert) and notify service owner. 5) Postmortem + reduce token TTL or increase rollout window.
Tom: add server-side header X-JWKS-Age (ms) and metric jwks.age. That helps detect lag.
Raj: CI gate idea: when changing kid/AUD, create a rollout PR that includes a canary token and a small traffic canary check via synthetic that validates on a canary ingress before global rollout.
Priya: security note: do NOT permit permanent dual-aud without approval. aud_rollout_window must default to 0 (off) and be opt-in per service during rollout.
ops-bot: Deploy note: jwks-distributor v2.1 rolled to canary at 1833333336 :rocket:
Maya: client SDK guidance: verify with caching strategy: cache TTL 5m but allow stale-verification grace 60s, background refresh interval 30s. Retry fetch on 503 with linear backoff 200ms -> 1s -> 2s up to 5s.
Raj: also add a dashboard panel: jwks.fetch.success_rate, jwks.age_percentile, auth.reject.invalid_kid over time.
Priya: I'll add audit event auth.keyrotation.{started|completed|failed} with fields [service,audit_id,new_kid,old_kid,rollout_window].
Maya: action items: Tom to PR runtime cache + header changes, Raj to add dashboards and canary test, Priya to add audit events and policy for aud_rollout opt-in. I'll update the incidents runbook with the above steps.
Tom: will include sample curl for canary validation in PR.
Maya: thanks all. tagging @oncall once runbook is in the playbook.
